passive.name: Prophet of an Elder God
passive.description: Illaoi and the Vessels she creates spawn Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain. Tentacles swing at spirits, Vessels, and victims of Illaoi's Harsh lesson. Tentacles deal physical damage to enemies hit, and will heal Illaoi if they damage a champion.

spells.name: Tentacle Smash
spells.description: Passive: Slam damage is increased by % (currently physical damage). Active: Illaoi swings her idol, causing a Tentacle to Slam forward.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TentacleDamageTotal was normalized. Unresolved parts: ByCharLevelInterpolationCalculationPart.

spells.name: Harsh Lesson
spells.description: Illaoi's next Attack causes her to leap at the target, dealing an additional max Health physical damage. When she strikes, nearby Tentacles will Slam at the target.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation HealthPercentTotal was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Test of Spirit
spells.description: Illaoi pulls the spirit from an enemy champion for seconds. The spirit can be damaged like a champion, with of that damage echoing to its owner. If the spirit dies or the target leaves its range, the target becomes marked for seconds and is Slowed by % for seconds. Marked enemies spawn Tentacles if possible. Tentacles will automatically Slam at spirits and marked enemies once every seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Leap of Faith
spells.description: Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies and spawning a Tentacle for each enemy champion hit. For the next seconds, Tentacles are untargetable and Slam 50% faster, and Harsh Lesson has a second cooldown.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
